niche: credit recovery placement for seniors short of the graduation schedule in a consolidated six-school district
answer: The 2027-28 recovery schedule brings 102 of next year's seniors to a regular high school diploma.
stakeholder_role: superintendent of a six-school consolidated school district

spine.entity: one course enrolment with the credits attempted and earned

driver: A filed procedure's delivered count is capped because two owed items that meet in the same time slot cannot both be taken by one unit, an exclusivity the schedule's data encodes but the governing procedure never mentions, and the closed record never paid for it because every past unit had a later period to defer into.
driver_concrete: Recovery sections meet in recorded periods (ELA 1, Mathematics 2, the other four areas 3), so a senior short in two period-3 areas can hold only one place and has no following year or summer section for the other, and the filed offer walk over all 286 short seniors brings 102 to a diploma rather than 121.
stump: A competent solver executes operations note 3.1 as the complete walk, takes every offered place and files 121 (or 143 or 166 if it also drops the seniors a place cannot graduate), never asking whether the schedule's period column stops a student holding two offers that meet at once.
